paragraphs: Jersey Watch sells software for running a youth sports organization, covering a website, player registration, payments, messaging and scheduling. The website builder is described as a manager built for sports volunteers who create pages, add photos and documents, and post schedules. Registration forms collect payments online, and donations can be collected from the website homepage or within registration forms.

Text and email notifications can be sent to teams, divisions, or an entire organization. Game and event schedules are posted on the organization website through the scheduling features. Background checks for coaches and volunteers are managed online, and invitations are sent to volunteers.

The about page states a mission to empower volunteers to build stronger communities through sports. Email is named as the primary support channel, with a Customer Care team to contact and video tutorials in the Help Center.
